newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Avimo buys 80 pct stake in U.S. Amarel.
newsitem.headline: Avimo buys 80 pct stake in U.S. Amarel.

text.p: Defence equipment group Avimo Group Ltd said on Friday it has through its subsidiaries agreed to buy 80 percent of U.S. Amarel Precision Instruments Inc for a consideration of US$10.97 million.

It said in a statement Avimo would acquire the remaining 20 percent of Amarel's equity on October 1, 1999 at a price between US$3.23 million and US$6.46 million depending on the financial performance of Amarel in the full year ending September 30, 1999.
Avimo said it will be financing the acquisition partly through existing cash resources and partly through additional bank borrowings in the U.S.

It said the acquisition fitted well with the group's strategy of expansion in high quality commercial optics. In addition, Amarel provided a platform for growth in the U.S. market, particularly since it is located in Rochester, the centre of the U.S. optics industry.
Trading of Avimo shares were suspended on Friday pending the announcement. Avimo has now requested that the suspension be listed on September 16.
